topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Meet letters & books
topics.goal: Recognize upper- and lowercase letters; follow print and distinguish letters, words and spaces.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Find the first word on a real page.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Listen to word sounds
topics.goal: Hear rhyme and syllables; blend, segment and change spoken sounds, including California phonemic-blending additions.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Say and blend sounds without showing written letters.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Letters make sounds
topics.goal: Connect common letter sounds to print, use basic phonics and recognize frequent words.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Build and read a simple word with letter cards.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: My first little books
topics.goal: Read emergent texts with purpose and understanding.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Read an appropriately decodable book together.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Tell me a story
topics.goal: With support, discuss details, characters and setting; retell and compare familiar stories.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Retell using three drawings; RL.K.8 is not applicable.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Discover in a book
topics.goal: With support, find a topic and details; use pictures, identify author/illustrator and connect information.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Ask one question about a nonfiction read-aloud.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Draw, tell & write
topics.goal: Use drawing, dictation and writing for opinions, information and events; improve work and join shared research.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Dictate, draw or write for a real audience. W.K.4, .9 and .10 are not active K targets.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Talk & listen together
topics.goal: Take turns, ask and answer questions, describe familiar things and express ideas clearly.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Tell a partner what happened and listen to their idea.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Words we can use
topics.goal: Build vocabulary and word relationships; develop grammar, letter formation, spelling and punctuation.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Label a drawing; sort words by meaning. L.K.3 begins in later grades.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: How sentences work
topics.goal: Notice sentence boundaries and the way a sentence begins and ends.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Locate a capital letter and end punctuation.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Blend & take apart sounds
topics.goal: Distinguish long and short vowels; blend and segment phonemes in one-syllable words.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Blend a spoken word before reading its printed form.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Read more word patterns
topics.goal: Decode one-syllable words, digraphs, final-e and common vowel teams, two-syllable words and endings.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Read decodable words without relying on picture guessing.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Read with understanding
topics.goal: Read appropriate text accurately and expressively; reread and self-correct to understand.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Listen to the child read; discuss meaning.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Story detectives
topics.goal: Recount stories and their message; discuss characters, setting, events, narrator and illustrations.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Compare two characters or versions of a familiar story. RL.1.8 is not applicable.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Read to find out
topics.goal: Identify main topic and details, text features and evidence; connect and compare information.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Use a heading or illustration to answer a question.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Make a little book
topics.goal: Write opinions with reasons, facts on a topic and sequenced narratives; revise, publish and research with support.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Create and revise a short real piece of writing.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Share my thinking
topics.goal: Build on a partner’s ideas; ask questions, describe clearly and support explanations with drawings.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Explain how you solved a problem to someone else.

topics.subject: ela
topics.title: Build sentences & vocabulary
topics.goal: Use developing grammar, capitals, punctuation and spelling; explore word meanings and relationships.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Write and improve a sentence; explain a new word.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Count & match
topics.goal: Say the count sequence to 100 by ones and tens; count on; connect one object to one number and say how many.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Count up to 20 arranged objects, or up to 10 scattered objects.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Numbers 0–20
topics.goal: Write numerals 0–20 and connect them to quantities, including zero.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Form numerals by hand; match each to a set.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: More, fewer or equal?
topics.goal: Compare groups and written numbers in the kindergarten range.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Match two groups one-to-one; compare written numbers 1–10.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Put together & take away
topics.goal: Represent addition/subtraction and solve story problems within 10.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Act out a joining or separating story with counters.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Ways to make a number
topics.goal: Decompose numbers to 10 and find the partner that makes 10; add/subtract fluently within 5.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Show more than one way to make 5.

topics.subject: math
topics.strand: Number and Operations in Base Ten
topics.title: Teen numbers
topics.goal: Compose/decompose 11–19 as ten ones and some more ones.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Bundle ten sticks and add loose sticks.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Compare & sort
topics.goal: Describe and compare measurable attributes; classify objects, count and order categories.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Sort objects into categories; category counts are at most 10.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Shapes all around
topics.goal: Name and describe 2D/3D shapes, positions and attributes; build, compare and compose shapes.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Find a real cylinder and construct a larger shape.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Adding & taking away
topics.goal: Solve addition/subtraction situations within 20, including unknowns and three addends.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Explain a story problem with objects, a drawing and an equation.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Smart number strategies
topics.goal: Use operation properties, missing-addend thinking and counting strategies; calculate within 20, fluent within 10.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Show how making ten helps. Fluency within 20 is not the Grade 1 requirement.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Balance the equation
topics.goal: Understand the equals sign; decide true/false equations and find an unknown number.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Explain why 3 + 4 = 5 + 2 is true.

topics.subject: math
topics.strand: Number and Operations in Base Ten
topics.title: Numbers to 120
topics.goal: Count, read and write numbers to 120 and represent quantities.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Begin counting from a number other than 1.

topics.subject: math
topics.strand: Number and Operations in Base Ten
topics.title: Tens & ones
topics.goal: Understand tens and ones and compare two-digit numbers using >, = and <.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Build 34 as three tens and four ones.

topics.subject: math
topics.strand: Number and Operations in Base Ten
topics.title: Work with bigger numbers
topics.goal: Add within 100 in the specified cases, find 10 more/less, and subtract multiples of 10.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Use tens/ones models; not unrestricted two-digit subtraction.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: How long is it?
topics.goal: Order and compare lengths and measure with repeated equal-sized units.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Measure a book with equal blocks and no gaps.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Hours & half-hours
topics.goal: Tell and write time to the hour and half-hour on analog and digital clocks.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Set a physical clock to a daily activity time.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Ask, sort & show
topics.goal: Organize and interpret data with up to three categories.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Collect a small class vote and compare the groups.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Build with shapes
topics.goal: Distinguish defining attributes; compose 2D and 3D shapes.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Build a shape and explain which attributes matter.

topics.subject: math
topics.title: Halves & fourths
topics.goal: Partition circles and rectangles into equal halves or fourths and describe the whole.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Fold paper into equal shares; formal fraction arithmetic is not a target.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Pushes & pulls
topics.goal: Investigate how the strength or direction of a push or pull changes motion; evaluate a design.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Compare toy-car motion in a controlled, adult-supported investigation.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Warm sunshine, cool shade
topics.goal: Observe sunlight warming surfaces; design shade to reduce warming.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Compare safe surfaces in sun/shade without touching hot objects.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: What living things need
topics.goal: Use observations to identify patterns in what plants and animals need to survive.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Observe a plant over several days.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Watch the weather
topics.goal: Record local weather patterns and explore how forecasts help people prepare.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Keep a weather picture chart and discuss safe preparation.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Homes in nature
topics.goal: Model connections between living things and their places; explore how organisms change environments.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Observe a habitat and explain a need it provides.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Care for our Earth
topics.goal: Communicate solutions that reduce human impacts on local land, water, air and living things.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Choose a realistic local action and explain what it helps.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Sounds come from vibrations
topics.goal: Investigate vibrating materials and use sound/light to communicate over a distance.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Observe a rubber band vibrating and design a simple signal.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Light, shadows & seeing
topics.goal: Investigate visibility with light and compare materials placed in a light beam.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Use a flashlight safely; never shine lights into eyes.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Nature’s clever parts
topics.goal: Explore external structures, parent/young behaviors and ways nature can inspire solutions.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Observe a feature, then sketch a nature-inspired design.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Parents & young
topics.goal: Use observations to explain why young organisms resemble, but are not identical to, their parents.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Compare plant or animal examples without generalizing from one image.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Patterns in the sky
topics.goal: Observe predictable sun, moon and star patterns; relate daylight observations to seasons.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Record daylight at familiar times; never look directly at the sun.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Ask, build & improve
topics.goal: Ask about a problem, sketch a solution and compare tests of designs.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Build and improve a small model with an adult. These are shared K–2 standards.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Design a helpful solution
topics.goal: Use drawings or models and compare design-test evidence to improve a solution.
topics.offscreenFollowup: Explain how a change helped the design. Not a distinct Grade 1 standard set.
